payload.interpretation: Small-scale exploratory simulation (20 planned per scenario). Metrics condition on explicitly counted valid estimates/intervals; paired MSE uses common valid datasets. Missing and diagnostic-failed fits are not successful.

payload.resume: Use the same config and implementation with a new future deadline; successful committed fits are skipped. Interrupted tasks remain eligible. Failed committed fits are preserved; retry only in a separate explicit attempt/campaign.
